01-main.en: Stand the sealed bottle or can upright on its own base with the closure and the neck foil complete inside the frame.

02-front.en: Face the main front label squarely with the closure and the neck foil in frame, and never rotate to the back label.

02-front.en: Turn the printed front face carrying the brand, the target animal and the net content square to the lens and keep the bag sealed.

01-main.zh: 按售卖枝数包装原样，不加瓶不加枝
01-main.en: Show the arrangement or plant with exactly the stems, blooms and wrapping present in the reference, and add no vase, no extra stem and no decorative outer pot.

02-front.zh: 最饱满的正面朝镜头，露出品名吊牌
02-front.en: Face the fullest side of the arrangement or the labelled side of the pot or bag to the lens so the variety, the colour and any printed tag read clearly.

03-selling-points.zh: 整株右侧陈列，看清株型与枝数
03-selling-points.en: Place the whole plant or bouquet on the right so its shape, its height and its stem count read at mid distance, and keep the bloom count identical to the reference.

04-detail.zh: 特写花瓣叶脉或盆沿基质质感
04-detail.en: Crop in on petal veining, leaf surface or the pot rim and substrate texture already visible in the reference, and open no bud the reference shows closed.

05-scene.zh: 家中窗台或桌面的日常陈列
05-scene.en: Place the item on a home table, windowsill or balcony floor in natural daylight as it would actually be displayed, and do not move it into a vase or any other container.

06-specification.zh: 品种与盆径标签面正对镜头
06-specification.en: Turn the care tag, sleeve panel or bag front printed with the variety and the pot diameter to the lens, and when nothing is printed show the angle where the sold size is easiest to judge.

07-detail-page.zh: 整株完整入画，明亮自然光
07-detail-page.en: Show the complete plant or bouquet as sold under bright natural daylight in the container and wrapping it actually ships in.

08-special.zh: 优先商品信息卡：品种盆径枝数养护
08-special.en: Show the real outer sleeve or shipping carton beside the plant or bouquet exactly as sold with the printed face to the lens, and add no vase, ribbon or extra stem.

detail_targets: the petal edge and its veining already visible in the reference
the leaf surface, vein pattern and stem node
the pot rim, drainage hole and its clay or plastic texture
the soil or substrate surface granularity

the printed front panel of a soil, fertiliser or seed bag

01-main.zh: 有外盒拍未拆封外盒，无外盒拍原封套袋
01-main.en: Use the closed retail box as the subject whenever the reference shows one, and when the reference shows no box present the item in the plain sealed sleeve or pouch it ships in, whole and unopened.

02-front.zh: 印品牌型号材质尺寸那面对镜头
02-front.en: Turn the box panel that prints the brand, the model, the material and the size toward the lens, or the printed face of the sealed sleeve when the reference shows no box.

03-selling-points.zh: 右侧立未拆封外盒，卖点交给文案
03-selling-points.en: Place one closed box on the right with its printed front to the camera so the pack format reads at mid distance, and stage nothing suggestive in the frame.

04-detail.zh: 特写盒边、材质纹或壳体接缝，避开印字
04-detail.en: Crop in on the carton edge seam, the matte material grain or a moulded housing seam the reference already shows, and stay off anatomical shapes and printed panels.

05-scene.zh: 空房间边几或浴室架，画面不出现人体
05-scene.en: Place the closed box on a plain side table or a bathroom shelf in a tidy empty room, and keep every person, body part, bed and bed linen out of frame.

06-specification.zh: 印型号材质尺寸那面转向镜头
06-specification.en: Turn the box panel that prints the model, the material, the size and the colour squarely to the lens.

07-detail-page.zh: 正面拍外盒，中性背景不做卧室氛围
07-detail-page.en: Show the closed box front on against a neutral calm background, and stage no bedroom, no bed linen and no human presence.

08-special.zh: 只拍真实外包装与未拆封盒，不出现人体
08-special.en: Show the real outer carton sealed beside the closed retail box with both printed fronts to the lens on a neutral surface, and keep every person, body part and bedroom staging out of frame.

02-front.zh: 表盘或镜架正面朝镜头，品牌型号原样
02-front.en: Square the dial, the frame front or the setting to the lens so the brand and the model marking stays exactly as printed in the reference.

03-selling-points.zh: 右侧放单件，控反光展示材质与工艺
03-selling-points.en: Place the single piece on the right and control the reflections so its metal finish, its stone setting or its frame profile reads at mid distance without a macro crop.

04-detail.zh: 特写链节表扣、铰链镜腿或滚花，不拍字
04-detail.en: Crop in on the bracelet links, the clasp, the crown knurling, the frame hinge or the temple tip already visible in the reference, and keep dial printing, hallmarks and caseback engraving out of frame.

05-scene.zh: 梳妆台或绒布托盘上，不上手不上脸
05-scene.en: Rest the piece on a vanity top or a soft tray where it sits when it is not worn, showing only the unit that is sold and no hand, wrist or face.

06-specification.zh: 盒面或表盘正对镜头，刻字不放大不修饰
06-specification.en: Turn the printed box panel, or the dial when the piece ships without a box, squarely to the lens at eye level, and never crop into or enhance an engraved hallmark, model or size code.

07-detail-page.zh: 单件完整入画，浅底柔光
07-detail-page.en: Show the single piece in one calm framing on a light ground with even reflection control, and add no light burst and no panel layout inside the image.

08-special.zh: 优先尺寸参数图；有真实礼盒才拍礼盒
08-special.en: Show the real presentation box beside the single piece opened no further than the reference shows, and add no certificate card, ribbon or second piece.
